page.layout: One page, title only, centred. Printed lines: "EPISTOLA", "AB", "ECCLESIIS SCOTICIS", then the subtitle in italic over three lines ending "1640.". No running head, page number or signature. The faint lines in the lower half are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Ad Helveticas missa, qua origo & progres-sus motuum breviter ostenditur, usque ad Kalendas Aprilis. 1640.

page.notes: The title is set in large spaced capitals with the subtitle in italic. The long s in "ostenditur", "missa" and "progressus" is transcribed as a plain s. The numerals "1640" are spaced on the scan and are copied as one number. The faint text across the lower half of the page is show-through and is not part of the page.
